# Content

Collections and Documents for a site, docs, a blog, a changelog or a help centre.

Packs are versioned with the standard, currently 0.1.0. Each model below has its own version.

## Models

| Model | Version | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [Collection](../models/collection) | v1 | A set of Documents published together: a site, a blog, a docs tree, a changelog or a help centre, with a slug and a public flag that publishes its published Documents. |
| [Document](../models/document) | v1 | One piece of content in a Collection: a page, a post, a docs article, a changelog entry or a help article, in Markdown, with a status from draft to published, authors, SEO metadata and an optional parent for hierarchies. |
